scope: Complete selected WindowNetworkState constructor and save overloads, exact DesignChrome update/updateMetrics/cancelUpdates/renderLatest/metadata methods and NetworkMetricsUi Refresh/update/updateNow/maintainNow. Handler, display-frame, catalogue, traffic/audit, async-store and live-projection boundaries are deterministic host adapters. The live boundary copies current synthetic session identity each invocation; it does not run real network projection internals. Async lambda capture inspection checks the identical observation passed to constructor and persistence. No Android, SQLite, native frame-time or network-speed measurement.
